basic_info.description: Tucked into the west slope of Telegraph Hill, just above the heart of North Beach, this fully-vacant duplex offers a roof deck with stunning city and Bay views, a coveted garage, and endless potential. Each charming 2-bedroom flat features an open layout and direct access to the spectacular roof deck with panoramic vistas of Coit Tower, the Bay, and the city skyline, an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining above it all. A rare bonus: the large garage offers parking and generous storage, an exceptional amenity in this storied neighborhood. Located in North Beach, San Francisco's beloved Little Italy, you're surrounded by world-class restaurants, sidewalk cafes, boutiques, and parks. Just minutes from the Financial District, the waterfront, and iconic city landmarks. Whether you're an owner-occupant, investor, or visionary, this is a rare opportunity to reimagine a classic SF property in one of its most iconic locations.
